events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Lille 0, Galatasaray 1. Yunus Akgün (Galatasaray) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
Goal! Lille 1, Galatasaray 1. Soriba Diaoune (Lille) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Alexsandro with a through ball.
Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Lille 2, Galatasaray 1. Soriba Diaoune (Lille) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Hákon Haraldsson.
Goal! Lille 2, Galatasaray 2. Aleksey Batrakov (Galatasaray) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Roland Sallai with a cross.
First Half ends, Lille 2, Galatasaray 2.
Second Half begins Lille 2, Galatasaray 2.
Own Goal by Berke Özer, Lille. Lille 2, Galatasaray 3.
Benjamin André (Lille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Lille 2, Galatasaray 4. Victor Osimhen (Galatasaray) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Baris Alper Yilmaz following a fast break.
Substitution, Galatasaray. Mario Lemina replaces Gabriel Sara.
